featured_reviews.name: James Parker
featured_reviews.review_text:
I came here while traveling to purchase a suit for a wedding, as I did not know ahead of time to bring one from home. The end products of jacket, suit, and pants do not fit my shoulders, arms, waist, or thighs. The only dimension that is correct is the hem of the pant at the ankle. I am lucky I can button the jacket despite it pulling. The pants I cannot clasp and my leg muscles show through the pants as what should be the front crease zig zags across my body.

I am fortunate the suit will cover my body enough for the wedding, but then I will have to give it away, as it looks embarrassing.

I am adding a star because at least I have something for the wedding and I can stretch the jacket to get a button clasped, and when the suit was not ready by the scheduled day, they did send someone to deliver it to my hotel. I sincerely appreciate that.

But I am completely confused how someone could measure my body and then produce a hand stitched product that does not fit me appropriately in any dimension.
